winning.note: Shore rake, stacks on the next column, cover beside the stacks, and a trail from the cover back to the anthill at (14, 5).

dry_pans.note: No shore rakes. Pans crystallize only after the first rain, when the brine has pulled back. Stacks and covers sit inland of the pans, with a trail back to the anthill. This plan misses the quota if the dry-season rule is ignored.

continued.note: The wet-season shore line, plus pans that wake up in the dry season and feed their own stacks and covers. The side marks stay off the trail so the first rain's haul matches the winning plan.

late_pans.note: A trail only, until the first rain. Pans, stacks, and covers are painted once the dry season opens, the way a player answers the brine pulling back.

all_rake.note: One rake region from the shore to the column beside the anthill. No stack, cover, or trail.

no_crib.note: The winning shore with no crib. After the dry season the cart beat has nowhere to put the bank, so this plan misses the cart.

carted.note: The winning shore plus a crib north of the anthill. The crib stays shut until the cart beat, so the wet haul matches the winning plan, and then the whole bank moves into the crib.

late_crib.note: The winning shore until the second rain. The crib is painted when the cart beat opens, the way a player answers the bank sitting still.

dry_crib.note: The dry-pan line plus a crib north of the anthill. Wet haul stays 0. The cart beat moves the dry-season bank off the covers and into the crib.

no_ship.note: The carted shore with a full crib and no ship. The ship beat has nowhere to send the crib, so this plan fails the ship check and the carted numbers stay put.

shipped.note: The carted shore, the crib north of the anthill, and one ship one cell north of that crib. The ship stays shut through the cart, so the wet haul and the cart match the carted plan. The ship beat then loads the whole crib onto the ship.

late_ship.note: The carted shore until the cart beat ends. The ship is painted when the ship beat opens, the way a player answers a full crib.

dry_ship.note: The dry-pan line, the crib, and a ship north of the crib. Wet haul stays 0. The cart moves the dry bank into the crib, and the ship beat loads that crib onto the ship.

no_stall.note: The shipped shore with a full ship and no stall. The market beat has nowhere to sell the cargo, so this plan fails the market check. The salt stays on the ship and the coin total stays 0.

sold.note: The shipped shore plus one stall one cell north of the ship. The stall stays shut until the market beat, so the wet haul, the cart, and the shipment match the shipped plan. Workers then sell the whole cargo at one coin per unit.

late_sold.note: The shipped shore until the ship beat ends. The stall is painted when the market beat opens, the way a player answers a loaded ship.

dry_sold.note: The dry-pan line, the crib, the ship, and a stall north of the ship. Wet haul stays 0. The market sells the dry-season cargo for one coin per unit.

no_yard.note: The sold shore with a full purse and no yard. The yard beat has nowhere to bank the coins, so this plan fails the yard check. The yard total stays 0 and the earned coins are still reported.

banked.note: The sold shore plus one yard one cell north of the stall. The yard stays shut until the yard beat, so the wet haul, the cart, the shipment, and the earned coins match the sold plan. Workers then bank the whole purse, one coin at a time.

late_banked.note: The sold shore until the market beat ends. The yard is painted when the yard beat opens, the way a player answers a full purse.

dry_banked.note: The dry-pan line, the crib, the ship, the stall, and a yard north of the stall. Wet haul stays 0. The yard banks the dry-season purse.
